description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code for the Plaid Settings doctype in an ERPNext integration, including UI event handlers, Plaid link initialization, and bank account synchronization logic.

classes.name: plaidLink
classes.description: A class managing the Plaid link integration, including script loading, token retrieval, and handling successful connections.

methods.name: init_config
methods.description: Initializes the Plaid link configuration, including product list, environment, client name, and link token.

methods.name: get_link_token
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the link token from the server.

methods.name: init_plaid
methods.description: Loads the Plaid script and initializes the Plaid link handler.

methods.name: loadScript
methods.description: Dynamically loads an external JavaScript file.

methods.name: onScriptLoaded
methods.description: Creates the Plaid link handler once the script is loaded.

methods.name: plaid_success
methods.description: Handles successful Plaid link connection, prompts for company, and adds bank accounts.
